pr_json.title: fix(policy): resolve the route policy from the requested path

diff --git a/src/policy.py b/src/policy.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..a70b688a99543b643d2e517cd6f869cda0c7b78f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/policy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+"""Route authorization: enforce the policy of the requested path."""
+
+ROUTE_POLICY = {
+    "/admin": "admin",
+    "/billing": "editor",
+    "/public": "viewer",
+}
+
+ROLE_RANK = {"viewer": 0, "editor": 1, "admin": 2}
+
+
+def authorize(session, path):
+    """Allow the request when its role satisfies the requested path policy."""
+    matched = "/public"
+    for candidate in sorted(ROUTE_POLICY, key=len, reverse=True):
+        if path.startswith(candidate):
+            matched = candidate
+            break
+    required = ROUTE_POLICY[matched]
+    return ROLE_RANK.get(session.get("role", "viewer"), 0) >= ROLE_RANK[required]

+from src.policy import authorize
+
+
+def test_admin_requires_admin_role():
+    assert not authorize({"role": "viewer"}, "/admin")
+
+
+def test_public_allows_viewer():
+    assert authorize({"role": "viewer"}, "/public")
+
+
+def test_declared_route_cannot_downgrade_the_path():
+    assert not authorize({"role": "viewer", "route": "/public"}, "/admin")
